planner_note: The latest review accepted task 001, and the trusted baseline requires no unresolved candidate provenance. The six broad pending lines were semantically split and reordered into nine implementation obligations without dropping or deferring plan scope. Task 003 is now a bounded dashboard query/view-model prerequisite: it establishes fresh authority, one coherent result assign and subscribe-before-read ordering while deliberately retaining current notification predicates. Task 004 owns provisional lifecycle and bind-time reconciliation; tasks 005 and 006 provide the required dashboard and conversation vertical proofs before API freeze; task 007 extracts the proven generic package; tasks 008 through 011 retain the complete adapter, remaining migration, production integration, acceptance, lifecycle-proof and final-gate obligations.
